summary: Eight-lane Euclidean and probability rhythm generator on note wires: each lane builds a Euclidean step ring (1 to 32 steps, pulses, rotation), a second Euclidean accent ring, per-hit chance, ratchets (1 to 4 repeats with ratchet chance), gate, divider (1x to 4x), note, velocity, accent velocity, MIDI channel and mute. Global clock rate (1/1 to 1/64, straight, dotted or triplet), swing, fill chance, humanize time and velocity, and a repeatable seed (0 = Free). It makes no sound itself: wire it on a note wire to Neo Drums, any synth or another note target. Use it for driving drum kits, polyrhythms, odd-meter grooves, ratcheting hats and polymetric synth lines.
use_for: Eight-lane Euclidean and probability rhythm generator on note wires: 1 to 32 steps, accents, ratchets, dividers, swing, fill and seeded humanize for drums or synths.

parameters.name: Rate
parameters.description: Base step length at the song tempo
parameters.how: Sets the base step length at the song tempo, from eight bars down to a sixty-fourth.
parameters.sound: Shorter steps run faster rhythms across all eight lanes.

parameters.name: Feel
parameters.description: Straight, dotted (1.5x), triplet (2/3x) or quintuplet (4/5x) step feel
parameters.how: Scales the base step length to straight, dotted (one and a half times as long) triplet (two thirds as long) or quintuplet (four fifths as long).
parameters.sound: Dotted steps add a syncopated lilt and triplets create a rolling three-against-two feel.

parameters.name: Swing
parameters.description: Delays every odd step by up to 75 % of a step
parameters.how: Delays every second step of each lane by a share of its step length, from 0 to 75 %.
parameters.sound: Higher swing turns straight divisions into a loose, shuffled groove.

parameters.name: Humanize time
parameters.description: Random positive timing offset per hit (0 … 20 ms)
parameters.how: Delays each hit by a random offset up to this many milliseconds, repeatable for a fixed seed.
parameters.sound: Small amounts soften rigid grid timing so percussion feels played by hand.

parameters.name: Humanize velocity
parameters.how: Varies each hit velocity randomly up or down by up to this percentage, repeatable for a fixed seed.
parameters.sound: Gentle variation stops repeated hits from sounding mechanical.

parameters.name: Fill chance
parameters.description: Probability of adding a random hit on empty steps (0 … 100 %)
parameters.how: Sets the probability that an empty step on any unmuted lane fires an extra random hit.
parameters.sound: Low fill values sprinkle occasional ghost notes and high values turn sparse grooves dense.

parameters.name: Seed
parameters.how: Chooses the seed for chance, fill, ratchet chance and humanize rolls; 0 (Free) varies every run, while 1 to 9999 repeats identically.
parameters.sound: A fixed seed locks probabilistic grooves so the same bar plays the same way every time.

parameters.name: L1 steps
parameters.how: Sets how many steps lane 1 cycles through before wrapping around, from 1 to 32.
parameters.sound: Lengths that do not divide 16 create polymetric rhythms that shift against the bar.

parameters.name: L1 pulses
parameters.how: Sets how many hits lane 1 distributes evenly across its steps via Bjorklund's algorithm (clamped to steps).
parameters.sound: Zero silences the main ring while higher values build denser grooves up to every step.

parameters.name: L1 rotation
parameters.how: Shifts lane 1's Euclidean hits forward around its step ring by this many steps (clamped to steps minus 1).
parameters.sound: Rotating shifts downbeats into off-beats and locks interlocking lanes around each other.

parameters.name: L1 chance
parameters.how: Sets the probability that each active step on lane 1 fires its note, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Lowering chance drops occasional hits for breathing, evolving percussion.

parameters.name: L1 accent pulses
parameters.how: Sets how many steps in lane 1's second Euclidean accent ring use the accent velocity (clamped to steps).
parameters.sound: Accents emphasize selected hits so grooves push and pull dynamically.

parameters.name: L1 accent rot
parameters.how: Shifts lane 1's accent ring forward around its steps by this many steps (clamped to steps minus 1).
parameters.sound: Moving the accent ring changes which hits pop forward without changing the rhythm itself.

parameters.name: L1 note
parameters.how: Chooses the MIDI note number lane 1 sends on the note port, from 0 to 127.
parameters.sound: Maps the lane to a drum voice in Neo Drums or a pitch on any synth.

parameters.name: L1 velocity
parameters.how: Sets the MIDI velocity sent for non-accented hits on lane 1, from 1 to 127.
parameters.sound: Lower velocities sit quietly as ghost notes and higher values hit harder.

parameters.name: L1 accent vel
parameters.how: Sets the MIDI velocity sent when a hit on lane 1 lands on an accented step, from 1 to 127.
parameters.sound: Setting this above the base velocity makes accented steps punch through the groove.

parameters.name: L1 gate
parameters.description: Lane 1 note gate length (5 … 100 % of step)
parameters.how: Sets how long each note from lane 1 is held as a share of its step slot, from 5 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Short gates make tight percussive stabs and long gates let synth notes sustain across the step.

parameters.name: L1 ratchet
parameters.how: Subdivides a firing step on lane 1 into 1 to 4 rapid evenly spaced repeats when ratchet chance passes.
parameters.sound: Adds crisp snare rolls, hi-hat flurries and rapid melodic trills inside the beat.

parameters.name: L1 ratchet chance
parameters.description: Lane 1 probability of ratcheting a firing hit (0 … 100 %)
parameters.how: Sets the probability that a firing hit on lane 1 triggers its ratchet repeats, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Moderate values add occasional surprise rolls without cluttering every hit.

parameters.name: L1 divider
parameters.how: Divides the global step rate for lane 1 by 1, 2, 3 or 4 so the lane steps more slowly.
parameters.sound: Slower dividers anchor bass notes and slow accents underneath fast percussion lanes.

parameters.name: L1 channel
parameters.how: Selects the MIDI channel lane 1 tags onto its outgoing note messages, from 1 to 16.
parameters.sound: Useful when wiring to multi-channel instruments or splitting channels across targets.

parameters.name: L1 mute
parameters.how: Silences lane 1, immediately releasing any sounding note it owns and blocking both hits and fills.
parameters.sound: Lets you drop individual voices in and out of a rhythm without losing their settings.

parameters.sound: Lets you drop individual voices in and out of a rhythm without losing their settings.

parameters.name: Timing
parameters.description: Whether steps follow the song's tempo or run on a time in milliseconds
parameters.how: Chooses between steps locked to the song's tempo and steps of a fixed length in milliseconds.
parameters.sound: Song tempo keeps the rhythm in time with the music; Free time runs at its own speed, whatever the tempo.

parameters.name: Free time
parameters.description: The length of a step in milliseconds when Timing is Free time (20 … 2000)
parameters.how: Sets the step length in milliseconds, from 20 to 2000, when Timing is Free time.
parameters.sound: Short times run a fast, tempo-independent rhythm; long ones a slow, spacious one.
